title: 3010. Divide an Array Into Subarrays With Minimum Cost I

examples.explanation: The best possible way to form 3 subarrays is: [1], [2], and [3,12] at a total cost of 1 + 2 + 3 = 6. The other possible ways to form 3 subarrays are: - [1], [2,3], and [12] at a total cost of 1 + 2 + 12 = 15. - [1,2], [3], and [12] at a total cost of 1 + 3 + 12 = 16.
The best possible way to form 3 subarrays is: [5], [4], and [3] at a total cost of 5 + 4 + 3 = 12. It can be shown that 12 is the minimum cost achievable.
The best possible way to form 3 subarrays is: [10,3], [1], and [1] at a total cost of 10 + 1 + 1 = 12. It can be shown that 12 is the minimum cost achievable.
